basis.common_data: same observed realization may be consumed by every method; no concurrent duplicate producer is needed
basis.observed_size_expression: O(S_kept*3222) text bytes for two observed exports plus manifests; no simulated S inferred from a real dataset
basis.observed_streaming: one genotype/error row at a time, no S-by-N genotype matrix retained; public VCF and haps duplicate observed data
basis.private_dump: native tskit dump size is checked after write; root must enforce disk quota during native dump
basis.row_storage: O(3222) calls/uniforms plus formatted strings; full ancestry/mutation tree sequence remains resident
basis.unknown: native ancestry/mutation table peak/RSS and number of simulated mutation sites S are unmeasured; caps are fail-stop allowances, not measured fit proof

scope: one parent at a time; CPU only; root wrapper must enforce actual quotas/timeout/RSS and authenticate source/request
